summary: Octave Intelligence plc filed an 8-K reporting the SEC effectiveness of its Form 10 registration statement for a spin-off from Hexagon AB. On May 22, 2026, Hexagon will distribute Octave Class A and B shares to Hexagon shareholders in a ratio of 1 Octave share per 10 Hexagon shares, with B shares delivered as Swedish Depository Receipts traded on Nasdaq Stockholm. The distribution is effective on the record date of May 22, 2026. Watch for trading commencement of Octave SDRs and potential arbitrage on the distribution ratio.
